            如何优雅地实现每 5 秒轮询请求？

                    阅读5分钟
                  </span> <!----></div></div> <div style="flex:1;" data-v-61fb5e44=""></div> <!----> <!----></div> <!----> <!----> <!----> <!----> <div id="article-root" itemprop="articleBody" class="main" data-v-61fb5e44=""><div class="article-viewer markdown-body result"><p>在做实时监控系统时，比如服务器状态面板、订单处理中心或物联网设备看板，<strong>每隔 5 秒自动拉取最新数据</strong>是再常见不过的需求了。</p>
<p>但你有没有遇到过这些问题？</p>
<ul>
<li>页面切到后台还在疯狂发请求，浪费资源</li>
<li>上一次请求还没回来，下一次又发了，接口雪崩</li>
<li>用户切换标签页回来，发现数据“卡”在旧状态</li>
<li>页面销毁了定时器还在跑，内存泄漏</li>
</ul>
<p>今天我就以一个<strong>运维监控平台</strong>的真实场景为例，带你从“能用”做到“好用”。</p>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-0">一、问题场景：设备在线状态轮询</h2>
<p>假设我们要做一个 IDC 机房设备监控页，需求如下：</p>
<ul>
<li>每 5 秒查询一次所有服务器的在线状态</li>
<li>接口 <code>/api/servers/status</code> 响应较慢（平均 1.2s）</li>
<li>用户可能切换到其他标签页处理邮件</li>
<li>页面关闭时必须停止轮询</li>
</ul>
<p>如果直接写个 <code>setInterval</code>，很容易踩坑。我们一步步来优化。</p>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-1">二、第一版：基础轮询（能跑，但有隐患）</h2>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { ref, onMounted, onUnmounted } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'vue'</span>

<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> servers = <span class="hljs-title function_">ref</span>([])
<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> timer = <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>

<span class="hljs-title function_">onMounted</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">poll</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
    <span class="hljs-title function_">fetch</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'/api/servers/status'</span>)
      .<span class="hljs-title function_">then</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">res</span> =&gt;</span> res.<span class="hljs-title function_">json</span>())
      .<span class="hljs-title function_">then</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">data</span> =&gt;</span> {
        servers.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = data
      })
  }

  <span class="hljs-title function_">poll</span>() <span class="hljs-comment">// 首次立即执行</span>
  timer = <span class="hljs-built_in">setInterval</span>(poll, <span class="hljs-number">5000</span>) <span class="hljs-comment">// 每5秒轮询</span>
})

<span class="hljs-title function_">onUnmounted</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-built_in">clearInterval</span>(timer) <span class="hljs-comment">// 🔍 清理定时器</span>
})
</code></pre>
<p>✅ 实现了基本功能<br>
❌ 但存在三个致命问题：</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>接口未完成就发起下一次请求</strong> → 可能雪崩</li>
<li><strong>页面不可见时仍在轮询</strong> → 浪费带宽和电量</li>
<li><strong>异常未处理</strong> → 网络错误可能导致后续不再轮询</li>
</ol>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-2">三、第二版：可控轮询 + 可见性优化</h2>
<p>我们改用“请求完成后再延迟 5 秒”的策略，避免并发：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { ref, onMounted, onUnmounted } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'vue'</span>

<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> servers = <span class="hljs-title function_">ref</span>([])
<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> abortController = <span class="hljs-literal">null</span> <span class="hljs-comment">// 用于取消请求</span>

<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">poll</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">try</span> {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 支持取消上一次请求</span>
    abortController?.<span class="hljs-title function_">abort</span>()
    abortController = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">AbortController</span>()

    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> res = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">fetch</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'/api/servers/status'</span>, {
      <span class="hljs-attr">signal</span>: abortController.<span class="hljs-property">signal</span>
    })

    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!res.<span class="hljs-property">ok</span>) <span class="hljs-keyword">throw</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Error</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'Network error'</span>)
    
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> data = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> res.<span class="hljs-title function_">json</span>()
    servers.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = data
  } <span class="hljs-keyword">catch</span> (err) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (err.<span class="hljs-property">name</span> !== <span class="hljs-string">'AbortError'</span>) {
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">warn</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'轮询失败，将重试...'</span>, err)
    }
  } <span class="hljs-keyword">finally</span> {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 🔍 请求结束后再等5秒发起下一次</span>
    <span class="hljs-built_in">setTimeout</span>(poll, <span class="hljs-number">5000</span>)
  }
}

<span class="hljs-title function_">onMounted</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-title function_">poll</span>() <span class="hljs-comment">// 启动轮询</span>
})

<span class="hljs-title function_">onUnmounted</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
  abortController?.<span class="hljs-title function_">abort</span>()
})
</code></pre>
<p>🔍 关键点解析：</p>
<ul>
<li><code>finally</code> 中 <code>setTimeout</code> 实现“串行轮询”，避免并发</li>
<li><code>AbortController</code> 可在组件卸载时主动取消进行中的请求</li>
<li>错误被捕获后仍继续轮询，保证稳定性</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-3">四、第三版：智能节流 —— 页面可见性控制</h2>
<p>现在解决“页面不可见时是否轮询”的问题。我们引入 <code>visibilitychange</code> 事件：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> isVisible = <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>

<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">handleVisibilityChange</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
  isVisible = !<span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-property">hidden</span>
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'页面可见性:'</span>, isVisible ? <span class="hljs-string">'可见'</span> : <span class="hljs-string">'隐藏'</span>)
}

<span class="hljs-title function_">onMounted</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 监听页面可见性</span>
  <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'visibilitychange'</span>, handleVisibilityChange)

  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">poll</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">try</span> {
      abortController?.<span class="hljs-title function_">abort</span>()
      abortController = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">AbortController</span>()

      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> res = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">fetch</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'/api/servers/status'</span>, {
        <span class="hljs-attr">signal</span>: abortController.<span class="hljs-property">signal</span>
      })

      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> data = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> res.<span class="hljs-title function_">json</span>()
      servers.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = data
    } <span class="hljs-keyword">catch</span> (err) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (err.<span class="hljs-property">name</span> !== <span class="hljs-string">'AbortError'</span>) {
        <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">warn</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'轮询失败:'</span>, err)
      }
    } <span class="hljs-keyword">finally</span> {
      <span class="hljs-comment">// 🔍 只有页面可见时才继续轮询</span>
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (isVisible) {
        <span class="hljs-built_in">setTimeout</span>(poll, <span class="hljs-number">5000</span>)
      } <span class="hljs-keyword">else</span> {
        <span class="hljs-comment">// 页面隐藏，等待恢复后再请求</span>
        <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'visibilitychange'</span>, <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">waitVisible</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
          <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!<span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-property">hidden</span>) {
            <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">removeEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'visibilitychange'</span>, waitVisible)
            <span class="hljs-built_in">setTimeout</span>(poll, <span class="hljs-number">1000</span>) <span class="hljs-comment">// 恢复后1秒再查</span>
          }
        }, { <span class="hljs-attr">once</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span> })
      }
    }
  }

  <span class="hljs-title function_">poll</span>()
})
</code></pre>
<p>🔍 这里做了两层控制：</p>
<ol>
<li>页面隐藏时，<strong>不再自动发起下一轮请求</strong></li>
<li>页面重新可见时，<strong>延迟 1 秒触发一次查询</strong>，避免瞬间唤醒过多资源</li>
</ol>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-4">五、封装成可复用的轮询 Hook</h2>
<p>把这套逻辑抽象成通用 <code>usePolling</code> Hook：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-js" lang="js"><span class="hljs-comment">// composables/usePolling.js</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> { ref } <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'vue'</span>

<span class="hljs-keyword">export</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">usePolling</span>(<span class="hljs-params">fetchFn, interval = <span class="hljs-number">5000</span></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> data = <span class="hljs-title function_">ref</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">null</span>)
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> loading = <span class="hljs-title function_">ref</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">false</span>)
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> error = <span class="hljs-title function_">ref</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">null</span>)
  <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> abortController = <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> isVisible = <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>

  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">poll</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (loading.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-comment">// 防止重复执行</span>

    loading.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>
    error.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">null</span>

    <span class="hljs-keyword">try</span> {
      abortController?.<span class="hljs-title function_">abort</span>()
      abortController = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">AbortController</span>()

      <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> result = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">fetchFn</span>(abortController.<span class="hljs-property">signal</span>)
      data.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = result
    } <span class="hljs-keyword">catch</span> (err) {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (err.<span class="hljs-property">name</span> !== <span class="hljs-string">'AbortError'</span>) {
        error.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = err
        <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">warn</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'Polling error:'</span>, err)
      }
    } <span class="hljs-keyword">finally</span> {
      loading.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>
      <span class="hljs-comment">// 🔍 根据可见性决定是否继续</span>
      <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (isVisible) {
        <span class="hljs-built_in">setTimeout</span>(poll, interval)
      }
    }
  }

  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">start</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 移除旧监听避免重复</span>
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">removeEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'visibilitychange'</span>, handleVisibility)
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">addEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'visibilitychange'</span>, handleVisibility)
    <span class="hljs-title function_">poll</span>()
  }

  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">stop</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
    abortController?.<span class="hljs-title function_">abort</span>()
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">removeEventListener</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'visibilitychange'</span>, handleVisibility)
  }

  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">handleVisibility</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
    isVisible = !<span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-property">hidden</span>
    <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (isVisible) {
      <span class="hljs-built_in">setTimeout</span>(poll, <span class="hljs-number">1000</span>)
    }
  }

  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> { data, loading, error, start, stop }
}
</code></pre>
<p>使用方式极其简洁：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-vue" lang="vue">&lt;script setup&gt;
import { usePolling } from '@/composables/usePolling'

const fetchStatus = async (signal) =&gt; {
  const res = await fetch('/api/servers/status', { signal })
  return res.json()
}

const { data, loading } = usePolling(fetchStatus, 5000)

// 自动在 onMounted 启动
&lt;/script&gt;

&lt;template&gt;
  &lt;div v-if="loading"&gt;加载中...&lt;/div&gt;
  &lt;ul v-else&gt;
    &lt;li v-for="server in data" :key="server.id"&gt;
      {{ server.name }} - {{ server.status }}
    &lt;/li&gt;
  &lt;/ul&gt;
&lt;/template&gt;
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-5">六、对比主流轮询方案</h2>















































<table><thead><tr><th>方案</th><th>实现方式</th><th>优点</th><th>缺点</th><th>适用场景</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><code>setInterval</code></td><td>固定间隔触发</td><td>简单直观</td><td>不考虑响应时间，易并发</td><td>快速原型</td></tr><tr><td><strong>串行 setTimeout</strong></td><td>请求完再延时</td><td>避免并发，稳定</td><td>周期不严格</td><td>多数业务场景 ✅</td></tr><tr><td>WebSocket</td><td>服务端推送</td><td>实时性最高</td><td>成本高，兼容性差</td><td>股票行情、聊天</td></tr><tr><td>Server-Sent Events</td><td>单向流式推送</td><td>轻量级实时</td><td>不支持 IE</td><td>日志流、通知</td></tr><tr><td><strong>智能轮询（本方案）</strong></td><td>可见性+串行控制</td><td>节能、稳定、用户体验好</td><td>略复杂</td><td>生产环境推荐 ✅</td></tr></tbody></table>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-6">七、举一反三：三个变体场景实现思路</h2>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>动态轮询频率</strong><br>
如网络异常时降频至 30s 一次，正常后恢复 5s。可在 <code>finally</code> 中根据 <code>error.value</code> 动态调整 <code>setTimeout</code> 时间。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>多接口协同轮询</strong><br>
多个 API 轮询但希望错峰发送。可用 <code>Promise.all</code> 组合请求，在 <code>finally</code> 统一控制下一轮时机，避免瞬间并发。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>离线重连机制</strong><br>
当检测到网络断开（fetch 超时），改为指数退避重试（1s → 2s → 4s → 8s），恢复后再切回 5s 正常轮询。</p>
</li>
</ol>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-7">小结</h2>
<p>实现“每 5 秒轮询”看似简单，但要做到<strong>稳定、节能、用户体验好</strong>，需要考虑：</p>
<ul>
<li>✅ 使用 <strong>串行 setTimeout</strong> 替代 setInterval，避免请求堆积</li>
<li>✅ 利用 <strong>AbortController</strong> 主动取消无用请求</li>
<li>✅ 结合 <strong>页面可见性 API</strong> 节省资源</li>
<li>✅ 封装为 <strong>可复用 Hook</strong>，提升工程化水平</li>
</ul>
<p>记住一句话：<strong>好的轮询，是“聪明地少做事”，而不是“拼命做事情”</strong>。</p>
<p>下次当你接到“每隔 X 秒刷新”的需求时，别急着写 <code>setInterval</code>，先问问自己：用户真的需要这么频繁吗？能不能用 WebSocket？页面看不见的时候还要刷吗？</p></div></div>
